## Runs 6–7 — field feasibility before the Landau fan (plan step 3)

These completed runs had not yet been promoted at handoff. The code below loads their raw channels first, then compares signed V/I and FFT windows; no absolute value or logarithm is used for the FFT, because the electron trace crosses zero. Measured current stays 9.843–9.935 nA (run 6) and 9.809–9.931 nA (run 7); |gate current| stays below 0.216 nA and T_sample is 1.165–1.292 K. There is no rail: |Vxx| corresponds to at most 0.53/0.59 kΩ versus the 5 kΩ nominal full scale.

Electron FFT features near 7.1–7.5 and 30 T persist across the 1.5–10 and 2–10 T windows; hole features lie near 5.0–5.3 and 12.4–12.5 T. Resolution is only 1.76/2.50 T in those windows, and broad background/harmonics contribute: these are candidate frequencies, not band counts. Automated onset is censored at the chosen 0.5 T lower edge and flags residual/harmonic ambiguities. The raw plots support a fan on both sides; they do not support a stacking verdict yet. The earlier spot-cell numerical mass/model claims lack a reproducible model in this handoff and are not used as evidence.

Plan step 4 will follow both carrier signs along the empirical D=0 line. Run 5 determines the ratio/offset, but the absolute density is still geometry anchored and the second CNP could represent inhomogeneity within the one wired voltage pair. Temperature damping, harmonics, and two populations must be separated before interpreting extra branches. Timing: run 6 took 120.36 min, run 7 95.68 min; measured overhead above bare field motion is about 3.08 s/set. Run 5's median gate point was 1.098 s at 1 s requested dwell; the fan uses 3 s dwell to honor the 0.3 s/24 dB settling floor.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
root=Path.cwd()
# Raw channels precede any reduction.
rawfig, rawax=plt.subplots(4,2,figsize=(12,10))
for j,rid in enumerate((6,7)):
 r=open_run(root/"data"/str(rid)); b=r.col("magnet_field")
 for a,col in zip(rawax[:,j],["sr1_X","sr0_X","sr1_P","T_sample"]):
  a.plot(b,r.col(col),lw=.7); a.set(xlabel="B (T)",ylabel=col,title=f"Raw data/{rid}")
rawfig.tight_layout(); rawfig.savefig(root/"hera_scratch"/"spots_raw_6_7.png",dpi=120); plt.show()
fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,2,figsize=(13,10))
for j,rid in enumerate((6,7)):
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); ch=resolve_channels(r.meta); ic=current_channel(ch); vc=next(c for c in ch if c.cid=='sr1')
 I=r.col(ic.col)/ic.gain; R=r.col(vc.col)/vc.gain/I; B=r.col('magnet_field'); order=np.argsort(B); B=B[order]; R=R[order]
 dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); dB=np.abs(np.diff(r.col('magnet_field')))
 print('RUN',rid,'rows',r.rows,'wall min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60,'R range',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',I.min()*1e9,I.max()*1e9,'T',np.min(r.col('T_sample')),np.max(r.col('T_sample')))
 print('median overhead after bare ramp',np.median(dt-dB*7.3*60),'dt',np.quantile(dt,[.1,.5,.9]))
 for c in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']: print(c, 'pA range',np.min(r.col(c))*1e12,np.max(r.col(c))*1e12)
 axs[0,j].plot(B,R,lw=.8); axs[0,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Signed V/I (ohm)',title=f'Raw run {rid}: B_1 - B_2')
 axs[1,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),I*1e9); axs[1,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Measured current (nA)')
 for lo in [1.5,2.,3.]:
  f,spec=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),nfft=4096,bg_degree=3,log=False)
  a=spec[0]; p,_=find_peaks(a); p=[p0 for p0 in p if 3<f[p0]<70]; pk=sorted(p,key=lambda p0:-a[p0])[:5]
  print('FFT',lo,'peaks',[(round(float(f[k]),2),round(float(a[k]),2)) for k in pk],'resolution',1/(1/lo-1/10))
  axs[2,j].plot(f,a/a.max(),label=f'{lo}-10 T')
 try:
  onset=sdh_onset(R,B,b_hi=10,b_lo=.5,r_full_scale=5000,bg_degree=3)
  print(onset.summary())
 except ValueError as exc: print('ONSET UNRESOLVED',exc)
 axs[2,j].set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='Frequency (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT'); axs[2,j].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch'/'spots_6_7.png',dpi=150)
plt.show()
# Timing calibration for gate scans; includes actual fast settling and gate writes.
for rid in [0,1,2,3,5]:
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); dt=np.diff(r.col('time'))
 print('TIMING',rid,'rows',r.rows,'wall min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60,'delay',r.meta.get('delay',r.meta.get('fast_delay')),'dt quantiles',np.quantile(dt,[.1,.5,.9]))

## HERA — Landau fan across both CNP populations (plan step 4)

> **05:23** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: B 0 to 10 T, 96 rows; nominal n -1.2 to +3.2e12 cm^-2, 111 points; empirical D=0, Si=0, base T; 3 s dwell · **ETA ~17:53** (≈12h30m)

Runs 6–7 show resolved field structure on both carrier signs (ana handoff analysis: candidate electron FFT features near 7/30 T, hole near 5/12 T), with current 9.81–9.94 nA and no clipping. A density–field fan tests whether branches track separate bands, harmonics, or the two offset CNP populations in run 5; a frequency count at one density cannot decide stacking. The only measured voltage pair is **B_1–B_2**. The line uses run 5's fitted c_bg/c_tg=0.772765 and empirical D offset −0.013 V/nm; density remains **nominal, geometry anchored**, and resistance symmetry is only an operational definition of D=0. Preserve the gate-voltage axes; do not make a stacking-dependent density calibration.

The fan starts with a **0 T reference row** from the handoff zero state, follows low-field reconnaissance at 0.5–1.4 T in 0.1 T steps, then samples 1.5–10 T uniformly in 1/B (85 rows, Δ(1/B)=0.006746 T⁻¹). The fast line contains 111 co-swept TG/BG points, nominal n=−1.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.04 increments, including both CNPs. This gives ~4.1 samples/cycle at F=36 T on the resolved segment; coarse low-B rows are not suitable for high-density FFT. Both lock-ins retain τ=0.3 s / 24 dB; each point has a 3 s interruptible dwell (10τ), Si stays at 0 V, heater ranges stay off. sr1 uses 100 µV (10 kΩ nominal full scale), with a 90% headroom stop.

**Coverage trade:** this spans both available carrier signs but omits the last ~0.07×10¹² cm⁻² at each TG-limited edge (full edge coverage would add ~22 min), negative B, and finite D. A reversed-field or finite-D repeat costs approximately another fan and is deferred until this map shows a discriminant. No gate-limit search, Si survey, or pacing change. **Price calculation:** 10 T / 0.137 T/min ≈73 min bare field motion; 10,656 points ×3.35 s ≈9.92 h; ~13 min row overhead, then 10% margin. This is calibrated from run 5's 1.098 s/point at 1 s dwell and runs 6–7's ~3.08 s magnet overhead above bare motion; extra co-gate writes/readbacks are included conservatively. Update the estimate after the first rows.

**Checks and decisions:** every inherited safety range, base thermometry freshness, field, Si, hardwired mapping, drive, lock-in settling, and gate pacing is checked before writing. Inspect the first point and the first complete 0 T row (compare run-5 CNP features and spot endpoints), then the first two finite-field rows; inspect every ~30 min thereafter and near 2 T for branch visibility. Every followed quantity has a live plot. Automatic stops flag |gate current|>1 nA, current collapse, clipping, nonfinite values, departure from base T, or field mismatch. If clipped, interrupt and reassess the acquisition range; if unsafe, notify and drop E0. Thermometry freshness is rechecked each row. End at 10 T with gates at the positive-density endpoint. **VTI exception:** a kernel interrupt does not stop an active magnet ramp; it continues to its last row target, and an unsafe ramp requires operator action on the supply. Re-read actual state after any interruption.

# Plan step 4: landau-fan; base T, empirical D=0, Si=0; one upward traverse.
# Read-only preconditions precede every hardware write.
import json
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.constants import e, epsilon_0

for _p, _expected in [
    (k_tg.volt, (-0.3, 1.0)), (k_bg.volt, (-1.3, 2.0)),
    (dc205.smart_voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)), (dc205.voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)),
    (magnet.field, (-10.0, 10.0)),
    (heater.sample_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0)),
    (heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0))]:
    _actual = (float(_p.vals._min_value), float(_p.vals._max_value))
    print(f'validator {_p.full_name}: expected {_expected}, actual {_actual}')
    assert _actual == _expected, 'SAFETIES differs from card; stop'
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Vt, _Vb, _Vsi = k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
_ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
print(f'expected base Ts 1.0-1.5 K, Tv <1.6 K / within 0.6 K; actual {_Ts}, {_Tv}')
print(f'expected handoff |B|<0.02 T, gates 0 V; actual B={_B}, TG={_Vt}, BG={_Vb}, Si={_Vsi}')
print(f'expected heater ranges (0,0), PS/output True/True; actual {_ranges}, {_ps}/{_out}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts) < .6
assert abs(_B) < .02 and abs(_Vt) < .001 and abs(_Vb) < .001 and abs(_Vsi) < .01
assert _ranges == (0,0) and _ps and _out
_rng, _dc_out = dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
print(f'expected DC205 range/output 2/1, ramp_rate .5 V/s; actual {_rng}/{_dc_out}, {dc205.ramp_rate}')
assert _rng == 2 and _dc_out == 1 and dc205.ramp_rate == .5
print(f'expected TG/BG steps .005 V and NPLC 1; actual {k_tg.volt.step}/{k_bg.volt.step}, {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()}')
assert k_tg.volt.step == .005 and k_bg.volt.step == .005
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
_card_wiring = {'source':'T_0', 'drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print('expected hardwired B_1-B_2, actual', WIRING)
assert WIRING == _card_wiring and 'mux' not in globals()
assert meas_config['sr0_gain'] == -1e6 and meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1) == 1
assert meas_config['bias_resistor'] == 100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel'] == 'sr1'
_amp, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f'expected drive 1 V / 13.777 Hz; actual {_amp} / {_freq}')
assert abs(_amp-1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(_freq-13.777) < .01
for _sr in (sr0, sr1):
    _tau, _slope = _sr.time_constant(), _sr.filter_slope()
    print(f'{_sr.name}: expected tau .3 s / slope 24; actual {_tau} / {_slope}')
    assert _tau == .3 and _slope == 24
print('expected sr0 sensitivity .02 V; actual', sr0.sensitivity())
assert sr0.sensitivity() == .02

# Exact run-5 fit; density in 1e12 cm^-2, D in V/nm, SI capacitance.
fan_cal = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
fan_n = np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111)
fan_charge = e * (fan_n - fan_cal['n_offset']) * 1e16
fan_diff = 2 * epsilon_0 * (0.0 - fan_cal['D_offset']) * 1e9
fan_vtg = (fan_charge + fan_diff) / (2*fan_cal['c_tg'])
fan_vbg = (fan_charge - fan_diff) / (2*fan_cal['c_bg'])
fan_B = np.r_[0.0, np.round(np.arange(.5, 1.41, .1), 8), field_invB(1.5, 10., 85)]
assert len(fan_B) == 96 and np.all(np.diff(fan_B)>0)
for _p, _vec in ((k_tg.volt,fan_vtg), (k_bg.volt,fan_vbg), (magnet.field,fan_B)):
    for _v in _vec: _p.validate(float(_v))
print(f'planned {len(fan_B)} x {len(fan_n)} points; TG {fan_vtg.min():+.6f}..{fan_vtg.max():+.6f} V; BG {fan_vbg.min():+.6f}..{fan_vbg.max():+.6f} V')

# Only acquisition-range change: no gate/field/T validators or pacing edits.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
assert sr1.sensitivity() == 100e-6
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'sr1_gain':1.0, 'Si (V)':_Vsi, 'sample_temperature:':_Ts,
           'gate_calibration':fan_cal, 'density_units':'1e12 cm^-2; absolute scale provisional',
           'D_target_V_per_nm':0.0, 'effective_point_dwell_s':3.0,
           'sr0_tau_s':.3, 'sr1_tau_s':.3, 'filter_slope_dB_oct':24,
           'comments':'landau-fan; B_1-B_2; empirical D=0; Si=0; n_nominal -1.2..3.2 step .04; B 0, .5..1.4, inverse-B 1.5..10; run-5 calibration'})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2, base T, Si=0 V, empirical D=0 V/nm; n=-1.2..3.2e12 cm^-2 (111), c_tg geometry anchored; B=0 reference + 10 coarse low-B rows + 85 inverse-B rows 1.5..10 T; 3 s interruptible dwell; sr1=100 uV')
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(fan_vtg[0]))
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(fan_vbg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
# Independent named measured field avoids ambiguous duplicate setpoint/readback columns.
B_measured_fan = qcodes.Parameter('B_measured_fan', unit='T', get_cmd=magnet.field)
fan_follow = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,B_measured_fan]
for _p in fan_follow:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time', _p)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X)
fan_counter = {'n':0}

def fan_before(station, writer):
    if fan_counter['n'] % len(fan_n) == 0:
        for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            assert_thermometry_live(name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
    interruptible_sleep(3.0)

def fan_after(station, data, writer):
    # [time,B_set,Vtg_set,Vbg_set,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P,B_measured]
    a = np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    fan_counter['n'] += 1
    reasons=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(a)): reasons.append('nonfinite readback')
    if max(abs(a[6]),abs(a[7])) > 1e-9: reasons.append('gate current >1 nA')
    if not (1.0 <= a[4] <= 1.5 and 0 < a[5] < 1.6 and abs(a[5]-a[4])<.6): reasons.append('temperature outside base window')
    if not (2e-9 < a[8]/mc['sr0_gain'] < 15e-9): reasons.append('drain current outside 2..15 nA')
    if abs(a[8]) >= .9*.02 or abs(a[10]) >= .9*100e-6: reasons.append('lock-in near full scale')
    if abs(a[12]-a[1]) > .03: reasons.append('field readback differs >30 mT')
    if reasons:
        writer.metadata['health_stop'] = '; '.join(reasons)
        print('FAN HEALTH STOP', writer.metadata['health_stop'], 'B=',a[12], 'TG/BG=',a[2:4])
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if fan_counter['n'] == 1 or fan_counter['n'] % len(fan_n) == 0:
        print(f'FAN CHECKPOINT points={fan_counter["n"]}, B={a[12]:.4f}, Ts={a[4]:.3f}, I={a[8]/mc["sr0_gain"]*1e9:.3f} nA')

s.register_run_before(fan_before, ())
s.register_run_after(fan_after, ())
# Effective dwell is in the interruptible hook; fast_delay=0 avoids a blocking dwell.
s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[fan_B],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[fan_vtg,fan_vbg],
                 slow_delay=3.0,fast_delay=0.0)
print('FAN END actual field/gates/T:', magnet.field(), k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si(), T_sample(), T_vaporizer())
# Hold endpoint (10 T after successful completion); no unrequested retraverse.
